Detection of Hate Speech Text in Hindi-English Code-mixed Data
Social media sites like Twitter, Facebook, being user-friendly and a free source, provide opportunities to people to air their voice. People, irrespective of the age group, use these sites to share every moment of their life making these sites flooded with data. Apart from these commendable features, these sites have down side as well.
